# Coordinate transforms apply in document order; a file may hold several scenarios.
static_galaxy_scenario = {
    name = "TRANSFORM_A"
    priority = 1

    coordinate_transform = {
        x = { add = 100 mul = 2 }
        y = { sub = 50 }
    }

    system = {
        id = 1
        name = "Transformed"
        position = { x = 10 y = 100 }
    }

    coordinate_transform = {
        x = { add = 1000 }
    }

    system = { id = 2 position = { x = 1 y = 1 } }

    # mul = 0 makes the transform non-invertible: preview only, no canvas editing.
    coordinate_transform = {
        x = { mul = 0 }
    }

    system = { id = 3 position = { x = 7 y = 7 } }
}

static_galaxy_scenario = {
    name = "SECOND_SCENARIO"
    priority = 2

    system = { id = 100 position = { x = -10 y = -10 } }
    system = { id = 101 position = { x = 10 y = 10 } }
    add_hyperlane = { from = 100 to = 101 }
}
